title: The Grandmother Who Saw a Missionary in Me
dek: She kept telling me I'd serve a mission, and I kept telling myself I wouldn't. She never got to see her words come true. But they did.
description: Jeff Boyer on his grandmother's belief in him, the night she passed, and how a mission to Brooklyn he never wanted became one of the greatest gifts of his life.

title: Three Bombs and a No-No: The Day I Still Stand On
dek: In 1995 I threw a no-hitter and hit three home runs in the same game. It took me years, a hard confession, and one night of prayer to understand what that day was really for.
description: Jeff Boyer on his miracle baseball game in 1995, the years he drifted from God, telling the truth at 21, and the foundation BILD is built on.

title: The $500,000 Check I Wrote Myself at My Lowest Point
dek: In 2010 I was scraping by and thinking about leaving California. What changed things had less to do with strategy and more to do with what I finally let myself see.
description: Jeff Boyer on losing his house in 2009, writing himself a $500,000 check, and what faith and imagination have to do with building a life.
